experiment: Window-only production-equivalent LSTM; 14/30/60 days, three seeds

protocol.selection: Mean outer-validation macro F1 over all folds and seeds; never select a seed using test. Window 30 is the fixed control.
protocol.deployment: Never automatically replace production; prospective evaluation required.

limitations: Historical test was already inspected; this is exploratory research, not a new blind holdout.
Comparisons concern retrained models with identical procedure; they are not retrospective scores of the published frozen weights.
Market regimes use the past 30-day return at issue time; regime scores with small samples are unstable.
Hyperparameter search increases overfitting risk; no automatic production promotion.
No sentiment/news is included; those observations are being collected separately.
